description: Generates boilerplate code (tests, mocks, stubs, configs) matching the patterns of a reference file. Can write directly to disk without consuming frontier output tokens.

model.description: Optional model override (or 'auto' to select the best available writer model)

provider.description: Optional provider override (gemini, groq, openai, deepseek, anthropic, ollama, openrouter)

reference_path.description: Path to reference file whose conventions, style, and structure should be replicated

spec.description: Description of what code to generate

target_path.description: Optional path where generated code should be written directly on disk

name: code_write
